Dude. What are you even talking about? And chalks and ink are a perfectly

interesting colors and good detail. Heck--he is wearing funny religious
vestments. Good stuff.

> You're commissioned to do artwork as a
> professional, it should be professional quality...

some very well established artists. Why pick on Ferrox, which is even very
well rendered?
